replacement of a valid passport lost or damaged
replacement of a valid passport lost or damaged, urgent

note: One fee for a new passport or a renewal, at any age (the page gives no age bands; children below 10 need no biometrics). Replacing a valid passport lost or damaged costs FJD 412.90 (536.75 urgent), in the same 10 and 3 working days, written as replacement routes. Validity is a lead.
